title: JANUS Linear A SigLA word-view interface probe specification

route_contract.evidence: The exact [word view] href ../../document/{SIGLA_ID}/index-word.html was observed on all three deterministic root-page probes.

pre_fetch_gate: Before fetching word view, refetch each document root and require exact SHA-256 equality with the parent interface probe. Any mismatch stops execution and requires a new interface freeze.
predeclared_observables: word-view HTTP status/final URL/content type/byte length/SHA-256
all anchors with normalized visible text
all class/id attributes with tag names
visible marker counts for word, words, sign, signs, syllabogram, logogram, fraction, numeral
ordered non-empty visible text blocks after whitespace normalization
forbidden: do not compare with mwenge content
do not derive word sequences yet
do not infer missing DOM structure
do not switch to a different document if a sampled page is inconvenient
success_gate: All three root hashes match, all three word-view pages return HTTP 200, snapshots and interface observables are recorded, and claim ceiling remains non-scientific.
next_if_successful: Freeze the SigLA source-adapter contract and then freeze a separate content-audit sampling/observable specification.
